title: 5 Claude Code Skills That Save You Hours

slides.title: Stop retyping the same *prompts.*

slides.title: Tidy your changes *before* review.
slides.text: Four agents check your changed code, then apply the cleanup.
slides.watch: It doesn't look for bugs. Use `/code-review` for that.

slides.title: A second pair of *eyes,* on demand.
slides.text: Reviews a branch, PR or path for bugs. Alias: `/review`.
slides.watch: No level typed? It reuses your last one.

slides.title: One instruction. *Many* parallel agents.
slides.text: Splits a big change into independent units, then works on them in parallel.
slides.watch: Needs a git repo. You approve the plan.

slides.title: Let Claude *babysit* it for you.
slides.text: Re-runs a prompt on an interval. Skip the interval and Claude paces itself.
slides.watch: Needs an open session. Ends after 7 days.

slides.title: Ask Claude to read its *own logs.*
slides.text: Turns on debug logging for this session, then troubleshoots from the log.
slides.watch: Off unless you start with `claude --debug`. It logs from now on.
